physics-e1-l1.title: Abubuwan da ke manne da maganaɗisu da ƙarfin maganaɗisu · Binciken tushe da muhimman ƙa'idoji
physics-e1-l1.concept: Maganaɗisu yana jan abubuwan da aka yi da ƙarfe. Sassa daban-daban (N da S) suna jan juna, sassa iri ɗaya kuma suna tunkuɗe juna.
physics-e1-l1.example: Kullin ƙarfe yana manne da maganaɗisu, amma rula ta roba ko gogewa ba sa manne.

physics-e1-l2.title: Abubuwan da ke manne da maganaɗisu da ƙarfin maganaɗisu · Nazarin gwaji da warware matsala
physics-e1-l2.concept: Abubuwan da ke manne da maganaɗisu da ƙarfin maganaɗisu – fassarar bayanan gwaji da iya warware matsalolin aikace-aikace a rayuwa ta yau da kullum ana haɓaka su.
physics-e1-l2.example: Ku cimma ƙarshen binciken kimiyya ta hanyar nazarin bayanai na adadi da nazarin kuskure.

physics-e2-l1.title: Girgiza da isar da sauti · Binciken tushe da muhimman ƙa'idoji
physics-e2-l1.concept: Sauti yana faruwa idan abu ya girgiza. Idan ka taɓa abin da ke fitar da sauti da hannu, za ka ji girgiza.
physics-e2-l1.example: Idan aka buga ganga, fatar gangar tana girgiza; idan ka sa hannu a makogwaro ka yi magana, girgizar igiyoyin murya tana isa yatsanka.

physics-e3-l1.title: Tafiyar haske a layi ɗaya da canjin inuwa · Binciken tushe da muhimman ƙa'idoji
physics-e3-l1.concept: Haske yana tafiya a tsaye madaidaici (tafiya a layi ɗaya). Idan abu marar haske ya toshe hanyar haske, inuwa tana yin a baya.
physics-e3-l1.example: Idan ka kusanta tazarar tocila da abu, inuwar da ke kan allo tana ƙaruwa.

physics-e4-l1.example: Nauyin $30\text{ g}$ a nisa $2\text{ ratsi}$ daga wurin dogaro yana daidaita da nauyin $20\text{ g}$ a nisa $3\text{ ratsi}$ ($2 \times 30 = 3 \times 20$).

physics-e1-q1.prompt: Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan ke faruwa idan aka kawo ƙarshen N da ƙarshen S na maganaɗisu kusa da juna?

options.a: Suna jan juna
options.b: Suna tunkuɗe juna

hints: Ka yi tunanin abin da ke faruwa idan sassan maganaɗisu daban-daban suka haɗu.
Ƙarshen N da ƙarshen S suna son juna kuma suna jan juna.
physics-e1-q1.explanation: Tsakanin sassan maganaɗisu daban-daban (N da S) akwai ƙarfin jan juna (jan hankali), tsakanin sassa iri ɗaya kuma akwai ƙarfin tunkuɗe juna (tunkuɗa).

physics-e1-q2.prompt: An sa kullin ƙarfe a cikin kofin roba mai haske, sannan aka manna maganaɗisu a wajen kofin. Idan aka ɗaga maganaɗisu sama a hankali, me zai faru da kullin?

options.a: Zai bi maganaɗisu ya hau sama a jikin kofin
options.b: Zai tsaya a ƙasa yadda yake
options.d: Zai guje wa maganaɗisu zuwa wancan gefe

hints: Ƙarfin maganaɗisu na iya ratsa roba ko takarda sirara.
Idan maganaɗisu ya motsa, kullin ma yana biye da shi.
physics-e1-q2.explanation: Ƙarfin maganaɗisu (ƙarfin maganaɗisu) na iya ratsa abubuwa sirara kamar roba, takarda da gilashi ya yi aiki a kan abubuwan da aka yi da ƙarfe.

physics-e1-q3.prompt: Suho ya yi bincike ta hanyar tara abubuwa da dama ya manna su a kan maganaɗisu. Wane ne daga cikin waɗannan ya haɗa abubuwan da ke manne da maganaɗisu kawai?

options.a: Ƙusar ƙarfe, kulli
options.b: Sandar cin abinci ta itace, rula ta roba

hints: Nemi abubuwan da aka yi da ƙarfe.
Itace, roba da leda ba sa manne da maganaɗisu.
physics-e1-q3.explanation: Ƙusar ƙarfe da kulli an yi su da ƙarfe, don haka suna manne da maganaɗisu sosai. Itace, roba, leda da gilashi ba sa manne da maganaɗisu.

physics-e1-q4.prompt: Wane ne ƙa'idar kimiyya a cikin sashin da ke taimaka wa ƙofar firiji ta rufe da kanta tare da danne ta sosai ba tare da rata ba?

options.a: Ƙarfin jan maganaɗisu da ke cikin rubar rufe
options.b: Ƙarfin caji na wutar lantarki

hints: A gefen ƙofar firiji akwai wani abu a cikin rubar mai laushi.
Yana jan jikin firiji da ƙofar da aka yi da ƙarfe.
physics-e1-q4.explanation: A cikin rubar rufe ta ƙofar firiji akwai tsiri na maganaɗisu da ke manne da jikin firiji na ƙarfe, don hana sanyi ya fita.

physics-e1-c.prompt: [Bincike mai zurfi] Idan aka ɗaure tsakiyar sandar maganaɗisu da zare aka rataye ta daga rufi aka bar ta ta tsaya, maganaɗisu yana girgiza na ɗan lokaci sannan ya tsaya yana nuni zuwa wata hanya ta musamman koyaushe. Menene dalili?

options.a: Domin duniya kanta babban maganaɗisu ce
options.b: Domin iska tana busawa daga arewa kawai
options.c: Domin hasken rana yana jan maganaɗisu
options.d: Domin nauyin iska ya fi yawa a kudu

hints: Yana da ƙa'ida ɗaya da yadda kamfas ke nuna arewa da kudu koyaushe.
Duniyarmu babban maganaɗisu ce mai sandar arewa da sandar kudu.
physics-e1-c.explanation: Duniya babban maganaɗisu ce wadda kusa da sandar arewa tana da halin S, kusa da sandar kudu kuma tana da halin N; don haka ƙarshen N na maganaɗisu mai walwala yana nuni zuwa arewa, ƙarshen S kuma zuwa kudu.

physics-e1-q5.prompt: Idan aka yanke sandar maganaɗisu gida biyu a tsakiya, me zai faru da ƙarshen guda biyu na maganaɗisun da aka yanke?

options.a: Kowane yanki na maganaɗisun da aka yanke zai sake samun sabon ƙarshen N da S
options.b: Zai rabu zuwa maganaɗisu mai N kaɗai da maganaɗisu mai S kaɗai
options.c: Zai rasa halin maganaɗisu gaba ɗaya ya zama ƙarfe kawai
options.d: Duka yankin biyu za su sami N kawai

hints: Ko da an yanke maganaɗisu zuwa ƙarami sosai, N da S koyaushe suna zama bibiyu.
Babu maganaɗisu mai sanda ɗaya kaɗai.
physics-e1-q5.explanation: Domin an jera lokacin maganaɗisu na kowane atom, ko da an yanke maganaɗisu zuwa ƙanana sosai, kowane yanki yana sake samun sabon N da S bibiyu.

physics-e2-q1.prompt: Idan aka buga cokali mai kaɗa sauti (tuning fork) da guduma ta roba sannan aka taɓa ruwan da ke cikin tanki da shi a hankali, wane ne abin da ke faruwa?

options.a: Girgizar cokalin tana watsa ruwa ko'ina
options.b: Kankara yana yin ƙanƙara a cikin ruwa

hints: Cokalin da ke fitar da sauti yana girgiza da sauri.
Idan abu mai saurin girgiza ya taɓa ruwa, ruwan yana yin raƙuman ruwa.
physics-e2-q1.explanation: Cokalin da ke fitar da sauti yana girgiza, don haka da zarar ya taɓa ruwa yana watsa ruwan ko'ina kuma yana yin raƙuma.

physics-e2-q2.prompt: Idan an yi magana ta 'wayar zare' da aka yi da kofunan takarda guda biyu da zaren siliki, wace hanya ce ke sa muryar abokin magana ta fi bayyana?

options.a: A ja zaren da ƙarfi har ya miƙe tsaye sannan a yi magana
options.b: A bar zaren ya yi laushi
options.c: A riƙe tsakiyar zaren da hannu sosai
options.d: A jiƙa zaren da ruwa da yawa

hints: Ana isar da sauti ta girgizar zaren.
Idan aka riƙe zaren da hannu ko ya yi laushi, girgizar tana ɓacewa.
physics-e2-q2.explanation: A cikin wayar zare, girgizar ƙasan kofin takarda tana isa ta zaren, don haka zaren dole ne ya miƙe tsaye don a isar da girgizar zuwa wancan gefen sosai.

physics-e2-q3.prompt: An sa hatsin shinkafa da yawa a kan babban ganga, sannan aka buga gangar da sanda a hankali da kuma da ƙarfi. Wane bayani ne daidai game da kwatancen?

options.a: Idan aka buga da ƙarfi, hatsin shinkafa yana tsalle sama sosai kuma sautin yana da ƙarfi
options.b: Idan aka buga a hankali, hatsin yana tsalle sama sosai
options.c: Ko da an buga da ƙarfi, tsayin hatsin ba ya canzawa
options.d: Idan aka buga ganga da ƙarfi, girgizar sauti tana tsayawa

hints: Idan aka buga da babban ƙarfi, fatar ganga tana girgiza sosai.
Idan girman girgiza (amplitude) ya fi girma, sautin yana da ƙarfi.
physics-e2-q3.explanation: Idan aka buga ganga da ƙarfi, girman girgizar fatar gangar (amplitude) yana ƙaruwa, don haka hatsin shinkafa yana tsalle sama sosai kuma sautin yana ƙaruwa.

physics-e2-q4.prompt: An kunna kyandir a gaban lasifika da ke kunna kiɗa da ƙarfi, sai harshen kyandir ya yi ta girgiza daidai da ɗan bugun kiɗan. Menene dalilin faruwar wannan?

options.a: Domin girgizar da ta fito daga lasifika ta girgiza iska
options.b: Domin kawai zafi ne ya fito daga lasifika
options.c: Domin haske ya fito daga lasifika

hints: Idan fatar lasifika tana girgiza baya da gaba, tana tura da kuma jan iskar da ke kewaye.
Girgizar iskar ta kai ga kyandir.
physics-e2-q4.explanation: Fatar lasifika tana girgiza kuma tana girgiza iska, kuma wannan girgizar iska (raƙuman sauti) tana isa ga harshen kyandir ta sa shi ya girgiza.

physics-e2-c.prompt: [Tunani mai zurfi] An sa agogon ƙararrawa a cikin kwandon gilashi mara iska (vacuum) aka sa ƙararrawar ta yi ƙara. Hannayen agogon suna girgiza suna bugun kararrawa, amma ba a jin wani sauti. Menene dalili?

options.a: Domin babu iska (matsakaici) da za ta isar da sauti
options.b: Domin a cikin vacuum sauti yana canzawa zuwa haske
options.c: Domin bangon gilashi ya shanye duk sautin
options.d: Domin girgizar agogon ta yi sauri sosai

hints: Don sauti ya isa kunnenmu, yana buƙatar wani abu da zai isar da shi kamar iska.
A cikin vacuum babu ƙwayoyin iskar gas ko ɗaya.
physics-e2-c.explanation: Ana isar da sauti ta girgizar wani abu (matsakaici) kamar iska, don haka a cikin vacuum da babu iska sauti ba ya isa.

physics-e2-q5.prompt: Idan aka buga xylophone, wane ne kwatancen tsayin sautin madannai gajere da dogo da ke daidai?

options.a: Gajeren madanni yana girgiza da sauri ya fitar da sauti mai tsayi
options.b: Dogon madanni yana fitar da sauti mai tsayi
options.c: Tsawon madanni da tsayin sauti ba su da wata alaƙa
options.d: Gajeren madanni ba ya fitar da sauti ko kaɗan

hints: Idan abu ya fi gajarta kuma sirara, yana girgiza da sauri a cikin daƙiƙa guda.
Idan yawan girgiza ya fi yawa, sautin yana da tsayi.
physics-e2-q5.explanation: Idan madanni ya fi gajarta, adadin girgizar abin a cikin daƙiƙa guda (mita) yana ƙaruwa, don haka sautin yana yin tsayi; idan ya fi tsayi, mita yana raguwa sautin kuma yana yin ƙasa.

physics-e3-q1.prompt: Idan aka jera zanen takarda guda uku masu ramuka a gaban hasken tocila, ta yaya ya kamata a jera ramukan don a ga haske a wancan gefe?

options.a: A daidaita ramukan guda uku a layi ɗaya madaidaici
options.b: A jera ramukan guda uku a karkace (zigzag)
options.c: A bar ramukan a ko'ina ba tare da damuwa ba
options.d: A rufe ramin zanen tsakiya da tef

hints: Haske ba ya iya bin hanya mai lanƙwasa.
Haske yana tafiya a tsaye madaidaici (tafiya a layi ɗaya).
physics-e3-q1.explanation: Haske yana tafiya a tsaye madaidaici (tafiyar haske a layi ɗaya), don haka haske zai iya ratsa dukkan ramukan ne kawai idan ramukan guda uku suna kan layi ɗaya.

physics-e3-q2.prompt: Ina so in sa inuwar tsanar beyar da ke fuskar allo ta fi girma. Wace hanya ce ta dace?

options.a: A kawo tsanar beyar kusa da tocila
options.b: A kawo tsanar beyar kusa da allo
options.c: A mayar da tocila baya nesa da tsanar beyar

hints: Idan abu ya fi kusa da inda haske ke fitowa, yankin da yake toshe haske yana faɗaɗa.
Gwada kawo abu kusa da tocila.
physics-e3-q2.explanation: Idan tazarar da ke tsakanin tushen haske (tocila) da abu ta ragu, kusurwar da abu ke toshe haske tana ƙaruwa, don haka girman inuwa a kan allo yana ƙaruwa.

physics-e3-q3.prompt: An haska tocila a kan abubuwa uku (gilashi mai haske, takarda mai mai, da kauri baƙar takarda) aka lura da inuwar da ke fitowa a bango. Wane abu ne ke yin inuwa mafi duhu da bayyana?

options.a: Kauri baƙar takarda
options.b: Gilashi mai haske
options.d: Abubuwa uku duka iri ɗaya ne

hints: Nemi abu marar haske (opaque) da ba ya barin haske ya ratsa ko kaɗan.
Haske yana ratsa gilashi mafi yawa, don haka kusan ba ya yin inuwa.
physics-e3-q3.explanation: Kauri baƙar takarda abu ne marar haske wanda kusan ba ya barin haske ya ratsa, don haka ana toshe haske gaba ɗaya kuma yana yin inuwa mafi duhu.

physics-e3-q4.prompt: A rana mai haske an lura da inuwar sandar tuta a filin wasa: da safe da yamma inuwar tana da tsawo sosai, a tsakar rana ƙarfe 12 kuma inuwar ta fi gajarta. Menene dalili?

options.a: Domin tsayin rana (altitude) ya fi yawa a ƙarfe 12 na rana
options.b: Domin gudun hasken rana yana ƙaruwa da rana
options.c: Domin tsawon sandar tuta yana ƙaruwa da safe
options.d: Domin iska tana hura inuwa ta tura ta

hints: Kwatanta lokacin da rana ke can sama daidai kan kai da lokacin da take haskakawa a karkace.
Idan tsayin rana ya fi yawa, inuwa tana raguwa.
physics-e3-q4.explanation: Idan tsayin rana ya fi yawa, haske yana saukowa a tsaye daga sama kuma inuwa tana gajarta; da safe da yamma kuma tsayin rana yana ƙasa, haske yana haskakawa a karkace don haka inuwa tana yin tsawo.

physics-e3-c.prompt: [Bincike mai zurfi] An yi ƙaramin rami a gaban akwati an ɗora takarda mai haske-haske a baya ('kyamarar ramin allura'), sai aka duba wutar kyandir, hotonta ya bayyana a juye sama zuwa ƙasa da dama zuwa hagu. Menene babban dalilin faruwar wannan?

options.a: Domin haskoki daga sama da ƙasan kyandir suna tafiya a tsaye madaidaici ta ramin
options.b: Domin haske yana yin tunani ya lanƙwasa a cikin ramin
options.d: Domin ruwan tabarau yana shan haske

hints: Hasken da ya fito daga saman kyandir yana tafiya a tsaye ta ramin ya isa ƙasan allo.
Zana hanyar tafiyar haske a matsayin layuka.
physics-e3-c.explanation: Hasken da ya fito daga saman abu yana tafiya a tsaye ta ramin ya isa ƙasan takarda mai haske-haske, hasken ƙasan kuma ya isa sama, don haka hoton yana bayyana a juye.

physics-e3-q5.prompt: A cikin ɗaki mai duhu, idan aka haska hasken tocila a kan madubi mai santsi, wane ne halin haske da ke faruwa?

options.a: 'Tunani' inda haske ke bugun saman madubi ya koma gefe mai akasin haka
options.b: Haske yana shiga cikin madubi ya ɓace
options.c: Haske yana ratsa madubi ya tafi bango na wancan gefe a tsaye
options.d: Haske yana rabuwa zuwa launuka da yawa ya zama bakan gizo

hints: Madubi yana mayar da haske yadda yake.
Kusurwar shigowa da kusurwar tunani daidai suke.
physics-e3-q5.explanation: Idan haske yana tafiya a tsaye ya haɗu da fuska mai santsi kamar madubi, yana canza hanyarsa ya koma; wannan ana kiransa 'tunanin haske'.

physics-e4-q1.prompt: An rataye nauyi mai nauyin 20 g a gefen hagu a nesa da ratsi 4 daga wurin dogaro na ma'auni mai hannu biyu. Don a daidaita a dama a nesa da ratsi 2 daga wurin dogaro, nawa ne nauyin da ya kamata a rataye?
hints: Lissafa (nisa ta hagu × nauyi) = (nisa ta dama × nauyi).
A hagu 4 × 20 = 80, don haka a dama 2 × (?) = 80 ne ya kamata.
physics-e4-q1.explanation: Bisa ƙa'idar daidaito, lokacin hagu ($4\text{ ratsi} \times 20\text{ g} = 80$) da na dama ($2\text{ ratsi} \times ? = 80$) dole su yi daidai, don haka dole a rataye nauyin $40\text{ g}$.

physics-e4-q2.prompt: Idan babban wan mai nauyin jiki 40 kg da ƙane mai nauyin jiki 20 kg suna wasan seesaw, ta yaya ya kamata su zauna don su daidaita su yi wasa cikin farin ciki?

options.a: Babban wan ya zauna kusa da wurin dogaro fiye da ƙane
options.b: Babban wan ya zauna nesa da wurin dogaro fiye da ƙane
options.c: Duka biyun su zauna a ƙarshen seesaw daidai
options.d: Babban wan da ƙane su zauna a kan wurin dogaro daidai suna haɗuwa

hints: Bangaren mai nauyi yana karkata ƙasa.
Dole a rage nisan bangaren mai nauyi don ribar (nauyi × nisa) ta daidaita.
physics-e4-q2.explanation: Dole nisan babban wan mai nauyi ($40\text{ kg}$) daga wurin dogaro ya zama rabin nisan ƙane mai sauƙi ($20\text{ kg}$) domin a daidaita.

physics-e4-q3.prompt: A gwajin daidaitawa, an rataye nauyin 10 g guda 2 a ratsi 3 a hagu na wurin dogaro. Nawa ne nauyin 10 g da ake buƙatar a rataye a ratsi 1 a dama don a daidaita?
hints: Jimillar nauyi a hagu 20 g ne kuma nisa ratsi 3 ne (3 × 20 = 60).
Tun da nisa a dama ratsi 1 ne, nauyin dole ya zama 60 g (nauyi guda 6).
physics-e4-q3.explanation: Tasirin ƙarfi a hagu shine $3 \times 20\text{ g} = 60$. Tun da nisa a dama shine $1\text{ ratsi}$, nauyin da ake buƙata shine $60\text{ g}$, kuma ana buƙatar nauyi $6$ na $10\text{ g}$.

physics-e4-q4.prompt: Menene dalilin kimiyya da ya sa idan aka ja ƙusa da ya kafu sosai a katako da guduma mai ja (claw hammer) ta hanyar riƙe ƙarshen hannunta, ana amfani da ƙarfi ƙasa da idan an riƙe tsakiyar?

options.a: Domin nisan daga wurin dogaro (lanƙwasar kan guduma) zuwa wurin da ake sa ƙarfi (hannu) yana ƙaruwa
options.b: Domin nauyin ƙusa yana raguwa kwatsam
options.c: Domin guduma tana samar da wutar lantarki
options.d: Domin katako yana narkewa da laushi

hints: Yi tunani game da ƙa'idar lever.
Idan nisa tsakanin wurin dogaro da wurin sa ƙarfi ya fi girma, ana iya samar da babban ƙarfi da ƙaramin ƙarfi.
physics-e4-q4.explanation: A cikin lever, idan nisa tsakanin wurin dogaro da wurin sa ƙarfi ya ƙaru, ana iya isar da babban ƙarfi zuwa wurin aiki da ƙaramin ƙarfi, don haka ana cire ƙusa cikin sauƙi.

physics-e4-c.prompt: [Tunani mai zurfi] Idan ana ɗaga babban dutse mai nauyi da lever, idan aka sa wurin dogaro kusa da dutsen (wurin aiki), ƙarfin da ake danna da hannu yana raguwa, amma ta yaya tazarar da hannu dole ya sauka take canzawa?

options.a: Tazarar da hannu dole ya motsa tana ƙaruwa
options.b: Tazarar da hannu dole ya motsa ma tana raguwa
options.c: Tazarar motsi ba ta canzawa ko kaɗan
options.d: Yana ɗagawa da kansa ba tare da motsa hannu ba

hints: Idan an sami riba a ƙarfi lokacin amfani da lever, ana yin asara a tazarar motsi.
A kimiyyar lissafi ana kiran wannan 'ƙa'idar aiki'.
physics-e4-c.explanation: Idan aka yi amfani da lever, ana iya rage girman ƙarfi, amma tazarar da hannu dole ya motsa tana ƙaruwa daidai gwargwado, don haka jimillar aikin da aka yi yana tabbatuwa (ƙa'idar aiki).

physics-e4-q5.prompt: Menene dalilin da ya sa ake iya motsa kaya mai nauyi da ƙarancin ƙarfi idan aka ɗora shi a kan keken turawa mai ƙafafu fiye da idan aka ja shi a ƙasa kawai?

options.a: Domin yayin da ƙafafu ke mirginawa, 'ƙarfin gogayyar mirginawa' a wurin taɓawa yana yin ƙanƙanta fiye da gogayyar zamewa
options.b: Domin ƙafafu suna rage yawan kayan zuwa 1/10
options.c: Domin ƙarfin jan duniya yana ɓacewa a kan ƙafafu
options.d: Domin ƙasa tana tura ƙafafu gaba

hints: Kwatanta girman gogayyar da ke faruwa lokacin da abu ke zamewa da gogayyar da ke faruwa lokacin da ƙafa ke mirginawa.
Gogayyar mirginawa ta ƙafa tana da ƙanƙanta sosai.
physics-e4-q5.explanation: Idan aka yi amfani da ƙafafu, gogayyar zamewa tsakanin ƙasa da abu tana canzawa zuwa gogayyar mirginawa mai ƙanƙanta sosai, don haka ƙarfin gogayyar da ke hana motsi yana raguwa sosai.

physics-e5-q1.prompt: Wane ne bayanin kimiyya daidai game da kwatanta saurin abu (gudu)?

options.a: Idan aka yi gudu a tazara ɗaya, ƙarancin lokacin da aka ɗauka yana nufin saurin gudu mai yawa
options.b: Idan aka yi gudu na lokaci ɗaya, ƙarancin tazarar da aka yi yana nufin saurin gudu mai yawa
options.c: Gudu shine ƙimar lokacin da aka ɗauka da aka raba da tazarar da aka yi
options.d: Idan abu yana da nauyi, gudunsa koyaushe yana da ɗaya

hints: A gasar gudu, ɗan wasa na ɗaya yana ɗaukar mafi ƙarancin lokaci zuwa layin ƙarshe.
Gudu = tazarar da aka yi ÷ lokacin da aka ɗauka
physics-e5-q1.explanation: Idan aka yi tafiya a tazara ɗaya, ƙarancin lokacin da aka ɗauka yana nufin gudu mafi sauri; idan aka yi tafiya a lokaci ɗaya, tazarar da ta fi tsawo tana nufin gudu mafi sauri.

physics-e5-q2.prompt: Idan aka tsara gwaji don kwatanta saurin ƙwallon ƙarfe da ke mirginawa a kan gangare masu karkata daban-daban cikin adalci, wane ne daga cikin waɗannan BA 'yanayin da dole a ci gaba da kiyaye shi ɗaya' (control variable) ba?

options.a: Kusurwar karkatar gangare
options.b: Tsayin farawa (wuri) da ake fara mirginar ƙwallon ƙarfe
options.d: Kayan saman ƙasa da yadda yake santsi

hints: Nemi yanayin da muke so mu canza don mu bincika (independent variable).
Don ganin gudu bisa karkata, dole karkatar ta bambanta.
physics-e5-q2.explanation: Domin muna son mu bincika gudu bisa karkatar gangare, karkatar gangaren 'abin da ake canzawa' (manipulated variable) ne kuma dole a canza ta, sauran yanayoyin kuma dole a kiyaye su a kullum.

physics-e5-q3.prompt: A gasar gudun mita 100, rikodin 'yan wasa huɗu kamar haka. Wa ne ya fi sauri? (Seonu: 14 daƙiƙa, Minji: 16 daƙiƙa, Haeun: 15 daƙiƙa, Jiho: 18 daƙiƙa)

options.a: Seonu
options.b: Minji

hints: Nemi ɗan wasan da ya ɗauki mafi ƙarancin lokaci wajen gudun tazarar mita 100 ɗaya.
14 daƙiƙa shine mafi ƙarancin lokaci.
physics-e5-q3.explanation: Tun da tazarar duk ɗaya ce, $100\text{ m}$, Seonu da ya ɗauki mafi ƙarancin lokaci, $14$ daƙiƙa, yana da matsakaicin gudu na kusan $7.14\text{ m/s}$, wanda shine mafi sauri.

physics-e5-q4.prompt: Wata mota ta bi wani sashe na babbar hanya mai sa ido kan gudu (jimillar tazara 30 km) cikin mintuna 15. Menene matsakaicin gudun motar a km a awa?

options.a: 120 km a awa
options.b: 60 km a awa

hints: Canza mintuna 15 zuwa sa'a don ganin kashi nawa ne na awa ɗaya.
Mintuna 15 = 15/60 awa = awa 0.25 (1/4 awa).
physics-e5-q4.explanation: Mintuna $15$ su ne $\frac{15}{60} = 0.25$ awa ($\frac{1}{4}$ awa). Matsakaicin gudu shine $30\text{ km} \div 0.25\text{ h} = 120\text{ km/h}$.

physics-e5-c.prompt: [Fassarar bayanai mai zurfi] A cikin jadawalin tazara da lokaci, wace ma'auni ce 'gangaren' layin jadawalin ke nufi, kuma wace ce halin motsin abu idan layin madaidaici ne mai gangare ɗaya? Zaɓi haɗin da ya dace.

options.a: Gudu — motsi mai gudu ɗaya (uniform motion)
options.b: Hanzari — yanayin tsayawa
options.c: Tazara — motsi da gudunsa ke ƙaruwa a hankali
options.d: Lokaci — motsi da hanyarsa ke canzawa

hints: A cikin jadawalin (canjin tsaye ÷ canjin kwance) = (tazara ÷ lokaci).
Tazara ÷ lokaci gudu ne.
physics-e5-c.explanation: Gangaren jadawalin lokaci-tazara shine (tazarar da aka yi ÷ lokaci), don haka yana wakiltar 'gudu', kuma madaidaicin layi mai gangare ɗaya yana nufin 'motsi mai gudu ɗaya'.

physics-e5-q5.prompt: Idan an yi tafiyar tazara ɗaya ta kilomita 60, mene ne bambancin lokaci tsakanin mota da ke gudun 60 km a awa da bas da ke gudun 30 km a awa?

options.a: Bas yana ɗaukar awa 1 fiye da mota
options.b: Mota tana ɗaukar awa 2 fiye da bas
options.c: Lokacin da motocin biyu suka ɗauka daidai yake
options.d: Bas yana ɗaukar mintuna 30 fiye da mota

hints: Yi amfani da dabara lokaci = tazara ÷ gudu.
Mota: 60/60 = awa 1, bas: 60/30 = awa 2
physics-e5-q5.explanation: Mota tana ɗaukar $60\text{ km} \div 60\text{ km/h} = 1$ awa, bas kuma yana ɗaukar $60\text{ km} \div 30\text{ km/h} = 2$ awa, don haka bas yana ɗaukar $1$ awa fiye.

physics-e6-q1.prompt: Ina so in kunna fitila ta hanyar haɗa batir 1, fitila 2 da maɓalli da waya. Wane ne sharaɗin 'da'ira mai rufe' da ke sa fitila ta haskaka?

options.a: Dole a haɗa daga ƙarshen (+) na batir ta cikin maɓalli da fitila zuwa ƙarshen (-) ba tare da yankewa ba
options.b: Dole a haɗa ƙarshen biyu na waya a ƙarshen (+) na batir kawai
options.c: Dole a sa zaren roba a tsakiyar waya don tara wutar lantarki
options.d: Dole a buɗe maɓalli a bar rata tsakanin wayoyi

hints: Wutar lantarki tana iya gudana ne kawai idan waya ba ta yanke ba.
Dole a haɗa ƙarshen (+) da (-) na batir gaba ɗaya.
physics-e6-q1.explanation: Don wutar lantarki ta gudana, dole a ƙirƙiri da'ira mai rufe (closed circuit) da ke farawa daga ƙarshe ɗaya na batir ta cikin sassan lantarki zuwa ƙarshen kishiyar ba tare da yankewa ba.

physics-e6-q2.prompt: Wane ne bayanin kwatanta da'irar fitilu 2 iri ɗaya da aka haɗa a jere (series) da wadda aka haɗa a layi ɗaya (parallel) daidai?

options.a: Fitilun da aka haɗa a layi ɗaya sun fi haske fiye da waɗanda aka haɗa a jere
options.b: A haɗin jere, idan aka cire fitila ɗaya sauran fitilar tana ci gaba da haskakawa
options.c: A haɗin layi ɗaya, idan aka cire fitila ɗaya sauran ma tana mutuwa nan take
options.d: Fitilun da aka haɗa a jere sun ninka haske sau 2 fiye da haɗin layi ɗaya

hints: Yi tunani game da yadda a gida idan aka kashe fitilar ɗaki ɗaya fitilar falo tana ci gaba da haskakawa.
A haɗin layi ɗaya, kowace fitila tana samun cikakken ƙarfin lantarki na batir.
physics-e6-q2.explanation: Idan aka haɗa fitilu a layi ɗaya, kowace fitila tana samun cikakken ƙarfin lantarki na batir don haka tana da haske sosai, kuma ko da fitila ɗaya ta yanke, da'irar sauran fitilun tana ci gaba.

physics-e6-q3.prompt: Idan aka lura da kallon wuri ko bishiya da ke nesa sosai ta hanyar haska su a kan allo da ruwan tabarau mai tudu (convex lens), wane ne siffar hoton da ke bayyana a allo?

options.a: Hoto da ya fi ƙanƙanta fiye da na gaske kuma a juye sama zuwa ƙasa da dama zuwa hagu
options.b: Hoto da ya fi girma fiye da na gaske kuma a tsaye

physics-m2-q3.prompt: Idan aka dumama ruwa da man girki masu yawa iri ɗaya da na'urar dumama mai ƙarfi iri ɗaya, menene dalilin da zafin man girki ke ƙaruwa da sauri fiye da na ruwa?

physics-m2-c.prompt: [Nazarin da'ira mai zurfi] An haɗa juriyoyi guda biyu na 6 Ω da 3 Ω a layi ɗaya, sannan aka haɗa su da tushen wuta na 12 V. Menene jimillar wutar lantarki da ke gudana a wannan da'ira gaba ɗaya?

physics-killer-12.prompt: A kan fili a kwance an sanya layukan ƙarfe masu jagorantar wuta guda biyu masu daidaito, tazararsu $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, kuma an haɗa ƙarshe ɗaya da resistor. Jimillar juriyar da'irar da ta ƙunshi layukan, sandar ƙarfe mai jagorantar wuta, da resistor $2\,\Omega$ ne. Filin maganaɗisu mai daidaito a tsaye $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ yana rufe dukan da'irar, kuma sandar tana motsi a kan layukan da gudu tsayayye $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ a hanyar da ke nesanta daga resistor. A tsawon $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ da sandar ta yi motsi $2\,\mathrm{m}$, magnetic flux da ke ratsa da'irar yana canzawa da $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Wane zaɓi ne ya haɗa daidai, bi da bi, ƙarfin wutar da aka jawo da ke gudana a da'irar, da girman ƙarfin waje da ake buƙata don kiyaye sandar a gudu tsayayye? (Babu gogayya.)
hints: Dokar Faraday $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=B\ell v$, $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}$. Idan gudu tsayayye ne, ƙarfin waje daidai yake da ƙarfin maganaɗisu kuma $F=BI\ell$.
$\Delta\Phi=0.5\times0.5\times2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $\mathcal E=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$.
physics-killer-12.explanation: $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$ ($=B\ell v=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot4$, sun yi daidai). $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}=\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$. Ƙarfin maganaɗisu da sandar ke samu $F=BI\ell=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ (a hanyar da take hana motsi bisa dokar Lenz) kuma tun da gudu tsayayye ne, ƙarfin waje ma $0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ ne. Tabbatarwa: ƙarfin aikin waje $Fv=0.125\cdot4=0.5\,\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\cdot2$. Idan aka manta da $\ell$ sai $I=1.0\,\mathrm{A}$ (amsa mara kyau ①); idan aka manta da $\ell$ a lissafin ƙarfi sai $0.25\,\mathrm{N}$ (amsa mara kyau ②); kuskuren ninka $\mathcal E$ da $\frac12$ shi ne amsa mara kyau ④.
